title: Proof of coulomb strong ratio q rational
html:
Proof (Lean-formalised)

Two-step in coulomb-strong-ratio-q-rational.lean:

  1. Algebraic identity (qDiffOverSum_eq_qSqDiff_over_qSqSum): for any real q \ne 0,

      \frac{q - q^{-1}}{q + q^{-1}} = \frac{q^2 - 1}{q^2 + 1}.

    Closed by field_simp; ring — pure-algebraic, generic-ring style.

  2. Transcendental bridge (Real.tanh_log_eq_qDiffOverSum): for any real q > 0,

      \tanh(\ln q) = \frac{q - q^{-1}}{q + q^{-1}}.

    Uses Real.exp_log and the definitions of Real.sinh, Real.cosh, Real.tanh in Mathlib.

The composite (prop:coulomb-strong-ratio-q-rational) is the immediate corollary: \tanh(\ln q) = (q^2-1)/(q^2+1) for q > 0.

q-usage discipline

The identity is stated and proved over \mathbb{R}_{>0} (the archimedean substrate-anchor regime). The fibre-level q-rational form (q-q^{-1})/(q+q^{-1}) is a Laurent-polynomial ratio over \mathbb{Z}[q,q^{-1}], realised at q = q_0 \in \mathbb{R}_{>0} where it agrees with the archimedean \tanh(\ln q_0). There is no |q| = 1 step (the identity involves q^{-1} algebraically, not as conjugation; both q_0 and q_0^{-1} are real positive points). Compliant with the lusztig_q_0_imaginary_part_zero invariant.
